title: Connect Finance Balance Sheet Trend v1
description: Fiscal years from finance_church_balances, one bounded row per year -- the multi-year sibling of connect.finance-balance-sheet.v1. By default every distinct fiscal year present, ascending; an optional from_year/to_year query window (both or neither, at most 20 years) names exactly those years, gaps included. Producers since 2026-09-26 also carry an additive parity extension -- per-year current/fixed/other assets, hasBalanceSheet, a Donor-Restricted split, cash and bank accounts, and net income, plus root cashAccountCode and pnlTieOut -- computed by the same functions as Connect's legacy finance/church/balances/multi-year route. The extension is all-or-nothing: either the root has both extension keys and every year has every extension field, or none appear.

years.description: Ascending by fiscalYear. May legitimately be empty when finance_church_balances has no rows at all.

totalsMatch.description: True only when every year's balancedCents is exactly 0 -- computed honestly from the real per-year figures, not hardcoded, unlike the single-year contract's own always-true reconciliation.totalsMatch.

cashAccountCode.description: The saved operating-cash account code (readCashPolicy); empty when none is pinned and checking accounts are matched by name.

pnlTieOut.description: computeBalanceVsPnlReconciliation over the listed years, with the year before the window read as opening net assets. One row per listed year that has a balance sheet.

status.description: ok within the $1 tolerance, off beyond it; no_prior_balance when the year before has no balance sheet; no_pnl when the year has no income statement.

asOfDate.description: The raw "As of ..." label from the import that produced this fiscal year's snapshot. Empty string for a fiscal year with nothing imported. Confirmed 2026-09-14: NOT a consistently formatted date across fiscal years (FY2019-2025 store the literal placeholder string 'FY<year>'; only FY2026 stores a real formatted date) -- never parsed or date-sorted, only ordered by the real integer fiscalYear.

assetsCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Assets' account in this fiscal year, group rows included, after the same applyDesignatedFundsAsEquity()/computeBalanceSummary() pipeline the single-year contract uses.

liabilitiesCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Liabilities' account in this fiscal year, post-reclassification -- does not include the '25000 Funds' branch, which reads 'Equity' here.

equityCents.description: Sum of ownBalanceCents for every 'Equity' account in this fiscal year, post-reclassification -- includes the '25000 Funds' branch. Always equal to netAssetsCents.

netAssetsCents.description: Defined as equityCents (total equity after the Designated-Funds-as-Equity reclassification), matching what the single-year contract's own 'position' page already labels 'Net assets' and production's own legacy multi-year 'Net Worth Growth by Year' table -- never a separately recomputed assetsCents minus liabilitiesCents figure.

balancedCents.description: assetsCents - (liabilitiesCents + equityCents) for this fiscal year. Zero in a correctly balanced import; reported as-is, never hidden, when it is not.

currentAssetsCents.description: computeBalanceSummary's current assets (asset group name contains 'current'). Extension field.

fixedAssetsCents.description: computeBalanceSummary's fixed assets (asset group name contains 'fixed'). Extension field.

hasBalanceSheet.description: False for a gap year inside an explicit window (all figures zero). Extension field.

equityReclass.description: computeEquityReclassification for the year, or null without a balance sheet. Extension field.

totalEquityCents.description: Always equal to the year's equityCents.

cash.description: computeYearCashSummary for the year, or null without a balance sheet. Extension field.

netIncomeCents.description: Net income from finance_church_entries (period_month=0, resolveChurchYearPrecedence + computeYearSummary), or null with no income statement. Extension field.
